title: 置顶后归档：置顶应自动取消
description: 先置顶一个会话，再把它归档。产品文案写明「归档会取消置顶」，数据库与界面都应体现这一点：pinned 归零、会话离开置顶区和活跃列表。
expectations: 归档已置顶的会话时不会把它留在置顶区
数据库 pinned=0 且 archived_at 非空
归档视图能找到该会话

db.sql: SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND pinned = 0 AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 8) WHERE length(title) <= 16 LIMIT 1
SELECT (pinned = 0 AND archived_at IS NOT NULL) AS ok FROM threads WHERE title = '{{target}}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
db.message: 归档后 pinned 归零且 archived_at 写入
